commit: 005dac1aded8f8f5acaf4e15dba56284015ae249
MIT, Copyright (c) 2015 Dave Kerr

vendor/crosswords.js is dist/crosswords.umd.cjs (classic UMD, window.crosswords).
vendor/crosswords.css is dist/crosswords.css.

vendor/puzzle.json is the original 4×4 word square (Sand). vendor/puzzles.json
adds two more original grids (Heart 5×5, Racecar 7×7). None of them are
Guardian or Alberich puzzles. Progress is saved in the file. A QWERTY pad
plus a hidden <input inputmode="text"> covers phones.

js-yaml 4.1.0 is bundled inside the UMD (MIT, Nodeca).
